claim.statement: Leader election should take under 5 seconds and full operability after leader loss under 20 seconds (5 s election plus up to a 15 s learning period during which no new work is placed); neither target has been measured.

sources.quote: Time to full operability after leader loss

claim.measurable: Kill the leader process; time to new leader in relish council status (<5 s) and until a new app apply places replicas (<20 s). The learning period ends when 95 percent of alive nodes have reported or 15 s pass; applies commit but are unplaced meanwhile; the data plane is unaffected.
claim.gap: Whitepaper section 2 table marks leader election, operability after leader loss, cold-start state reconstruction (<30 s) and node cold start (<60 s) as "Target (unmeasured)".
